home.thought: Love all, serve all. Help ever, hurt never.

act0.eyebrow: Sri Sathya Sai Seva Organisation · Delhi NCR
act0.title: Love all, serve all.
act0.body: Bhajans, study circles and seva (service) across Delhi NCR. Open to everyone, free always.

act1.title: Each day begins with prayer.
act1.body: Nagar Sankirtan through the lanes at dawn, and meals cooked by morning for those who need them.

act2.title: Five petals, five human values.
act2.body: Sathya, Dharma, Shanti, Prema and Ahimsa: the values behind every activity we run.

act3.title: Come as you are.
act3.body: Every activity is free and open to people of every faith.

sathya.name: Sathya
sathya.quote: Speak the truth. Speak it pleasantly.
sathya.body: Study circles meet weekly in every centre. One teaching is read, questioned and sat with until it is plain. No fee, no registration.

dharma.name: Dharma
dharma.quote: Duty is God. Work is worship.
dharma.body: Bal Vikas classes give children an hour each Sunday to learn the human values through stories, songs and silent sitting.

shanti.name: Shanti
shanti.quote: Silence is the first step to peace.
shanti.body: Bhajans (devotional singing) on Thursday and Sunday evenings, and Nagar Sankirtan through the lanes at first light. Anyone may sing.

prema.name: Prema
prema.body: Narayan Seva serves cooked meals through the year. Beside it run blood donation camps, eye camps, winter blanket rounds and hospital visits.

ahimsa.name: Ahimsa
ahimsa.body: Sapling drives through the monsoon, park and lake clean-ups, and water-saving work in schools.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.lead: We collect as little as we can, keep it only as long as we need it, and never sell it or share it for anyone's marketing.

short.s1: We mostly store counts: how many people came, never who.
short.s2: We store a few personal details only for follow-up care, such as a cataract operation, and only with your consent.
short.s3: We never ask for Aadhaar or any other ID number.
short.s4: You can ask us to see, correct or delete your details at any time.
short.s5: To contact us, use the request form on this page. We reply within 30 days.
